R1_tie_e37.what: mm16 on E37's fill reads E37's board watts over idle (leakage difference taken off) within the band, and every mm16 cell runs E37's cycles per op within the share

means.PASS: the ported loop is E37's benchmark, so its numbers tie to E37's 24-26 W
means.FAIL: the port differs from E37's benchmark: every mm16 number carries that difference, and the README says which way

R2_tie_e78.what: the resident cells read E78's S within the band, on the new binary

means.PASS: the session sits in E78's frame and the arms can be read against the kinds page
means.FAIL: the session drifted from E78: read the arms against this session's resident cells only

R3_premium.what: S(mm16) - r S(res), paired per pass, in each of zeros, ones, random, sparse50 and each format: the 95% lower bound is above the bar: a real matmul pays the memory path whatever the data

means.PASS: every per-kind watt on the page is low for a matmul that streams
means.FAIL: in that cell streaming costs nothing the loop did not: the page's number stands for it

R3b_model.what: rms of measured S minus the frozen S over the 12 cells of R3 (mm16), over the 12 of gemm1

means.PASS: resident power plus E37's path cost plus E75's prices predicts a streamed cell
means.FAIL: the three published numbers do not add up to a streamed cell, and the residuals say which term is off

R4_clause.what: E39's kernel clause on one fill: S(mm16.int8.e37) - S(res.int8.e37), paired: PASS if the 95% interval overlaps the frozen range and the mean is inside it; FAIL if the interval lies outside; else INCONCLUSIVE. fp32 and fp16 are reported

means.PASS: the +18 W of the claims register is the kernel, not the different fill
means.FAIL: part of the +18 W was the fill

R5_memory_data.what: M = [S(arm, random) - S(arm, zeros)] - r [S(res, random) - S(res, zeros)], paired, mm16 in each format, against E75's prices times the tile's changed bits. Three-way as R4. gemm1 is reported

means.PASS: the memory path's data-dependent power is the size E75's prices say
means.FAIL: E75's prices, measured on bare loads, do not carry over to a matmul's loads

R5b_memory_constant.what: [S(mm16, ones) - S(mm16, zeros)] - r [S(res, ones) - S(res, zeros)], paired: PASS if the 95% interval lies inside the band, FAIL if wholly outside, else INCONCLUSIVE

means.PASS: a constant costs the memory path what zeros do
means.FAIL: the path pays for the constant itself, not only for changes

R6_rank.what: Spearman rho between S(res) and S(arm) over the five kinds within each format, for mm16 and gemm1

means.PASS: the kinds rank as on the page
means.FAIL: streaming reorders the kinds, and the table on the page is the loop's

R7_gate.what: zeros' share S(arm, zeros) / S(arm, random) per format. R7a: the 95% lower bound is above the resident share E78 measured. R7b: the upper bound is below the bar

means.R7a: zeros' 5-7% of random is the loop's figure
means.R7b: the gate still saves a quarter or more in a real matmul
means.FAIL_R7b: in that format zeros hardly save power once the operands stream

R8_coop.what: S(mm16, random) - S(gemm1, random) and S(gemmnc1, random) - S(gemm1, random), paired, per format: PASS if the 95% lower bound is above 0, FAIL if the upper bound is below 0, else INCONCLUSIVE

means.PASS: the production pattern draws less than the benchmark: E37's watts overstate a cooperative GEMM
means.FAIL: cooperative loads do not save board power

R9_correct.what: no check record reads wrong; every zeros run reads exact; every int8 run reads exact

means.PASS: the kernels compute what they should on every kind
means.FAIL: a kernel takes a different path on some data: that is a finding, reported with the cells

R9b_cycles.what: within each arm and format the cycles per op of every kind agree within the share: the data does not change the count

means.PASS: as in the loop, the data never changes the cycle count, streaming or not
means.FAIL: the data changes the cycle count in a streamed matmul: the page's first sentence is the loop's

R10_heat.what: the OLS slope of the die's rise on S over every cell with S >= 12 W, all arms, lies in the band

means.PASS: a watt spent on the memory path heats the die sensor as a watt on the lanes does
means.FAIL: the memory path's watts reach the sensor differently, and the heat line must carry the arm

R11_dram.what: S(mmp64.fp32.randn) - S(mmp64.fp32.zeros), paired, three-way against the frozen range; its cycles per op inside E37's range +- 10%

means.PASS: the DRAM path's data dependence, at E37's traffic, is the size E75 and E81 say

R12_gemm16.what: S(gemm16, random) - S(gemm16, zeros), paired, per format: the 95% lower bound is above 0; the cycles per op and its ratio to gemm1's are reported, with no band: nothing predicted them

means.PASS: the kinds still set the power of a GEMM past the L3
means.FAIL: past the L3 the memory path's stalls hide the kinds

S1_fp32_burst.what: aifoundry2: zeros over random fp32, TFLOPS, 1.5-6.5 s of a 6 s burst from a cool die, gemm1 (and mm16 where the cool burst is allowed). GROWS >= 1.20 (the frozen prediction: 1.21, mm16 1.25); SURVIVES in [1.10, 1.20); SHRINKS < 1.10

means.GROWS: the page's x1.13-1.15 understates a matmul that streams
means.SHRINKS: the page's burst gap belongs to the loop

S2_fp32_sustained.what: aifoundry2: the same over the last 40 s of about 76 s. SURVIVES in [1.20, 1.40] (the frozen prediction: 1.33); else FAILS

means.FAILS: the sustained gap belongs to the loop: the README says which way it moved

S3_int8.what: aifoundry2: zeros over random int8, sustained, gemm1 and mm16. The frozen prediction: 1.19 and 1.22. SLOWS >= 1.05; HARDLY < 1.03; between: INCONCLUSIVE. The burst is reported (1.03 and 1.13 predicted)

means.SLOWS: 'int8 hardly slows' belongs to the loop: a real int8 matmul meets the trip
means.HARDLY: int8 hardly slows in a real matmul too

S4_relation.what: aifoundry2: rms of measured minus frozen clock (E83's relation on the frozen S) over the cells, burst and sustained

means.PASS: the chain kind -> watts -> clock carries over to a matmul that streams
means.FAIL: it does not, on the frozen S; the relation on session 1's measured S is scored beside it, labelled

S5_real.what: aifoundry2: the real set against random, in each format, gemm1: burst and sustained clocks within the bar

means.PASS: real float tensors stream at random data's speed
means.FAIL: real tensors and random data part once the operands stream
